title: Manage the product roadmap
summary: When multiple customer needs and product investments compete for delivery capacity. A prioritized outcome-based roadmap with explicit tradeoffs, accountable owners and a review cadence.
outcomes: A prioritized outcome-based roadmap with explicit tradeoffs, accountable owners and a review cadence.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When multiple customer needs and product investments compete for delivery capacity.

parts.title: Collect and classify product evidence
parts.guidance: Consolidate customer problems, usage, support findings, technical risks and commercial commitments. Distinguish evidence from feature requests and identify which commitments already have contractual or launch constraints.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Model options and dependencies
parts.guidance: For each candidate outcome, record the affected customers, expected value, engineering dependencies, operational cost and uncertainty. Identify research or security work that must precede a delivery commitment.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Choose priorities and capacity allocations
parts.guidance: Product and engineering owners review tradeoffs with the relevant commercial and risk owners. Agree the outcomes to pursue and explicitly defer work that exceeds capacity instead of publishing every request as a promise.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Translate priorities into owned delivery work
parts.guidance: Connect each selected outcome to an owner, success measure and the existing feature-delivery process. Record external communication commitments separately from internal target dates.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review results and revise the roadmap
parts.guidance: Compare shipped outcomes with customer evidence and actual cost. Update priorities and communicate approved changes to affected teams, retaining the reasoning behind major changes.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review results and revise the roadmap

verify.how: A prioritized outcome-based roadmap with explicit tradeoffs, accountable owners and a review cadence.
